_comment: Query MCP tools for whichever SigNoz this connector forwards to —
exposed to agents through aw-mcp-gateway. NO sidecar: `type: http`
points straight at an EXTERNAL signoz-mcp-server (the central one at
signoz-mcp.aw.tekflox.com today), the same no-sidecar shape
aw-app-browser already uses for its own stdio upstream pointed at a
CDP endpoint in a different container. aw-app-signoz's own 'mcp'
sidecar is untouched — this is a SEPARATE set of tools for whoever
only has the connector installed, pointed at the connector's own
destination instead of a per-workspace SigNoz.
This is a TEMPLATE. aw-workspace renders it into mcp.json — the file the
gateway's app-scan actually reads — on every activation and every config
save, resolving ${config.x} against this app's saved settings. Do not edit
the rendered mcp.json: it is overwritten, and the value you want lives in
the app's Settings instead.
query_mcp_url / query_api_key are MANAGED — pushed by aw-workspace
core's src/api/observability.py::_push_connector_config alongside the
existing endpoint/api_key, resolved from Settings > Observability.
While either is empty, the renderer disables this server and the
gateway serves no query tools — deliberately, because an upstream
configured with an unresolved placeholder does not fail loudly. It
connects, gets a 401, and serves zero tools, which looks like a
broken app rather than an empty field.
